projectMetadata.description: A comprehensive web suite for independent USANA distributors. Features a cinematic, gamified public-facing suite (System A) and private, offline-first business tools (System B).

architecture.frontend: React, Vite, Framer Motion (System A), Mantine UI (System B)

projectMetadata.importantNote: The FINAL-TECHNICAL-SPECIFICATION is outdated regarding System A. Always countercheck with MDs/PHASE-5.md as the absolute source of truth for the public UI.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Core features (System A - Cinematic Web Suite)

items.label: CinematicSection & Framer Motion Engine
items.instructions: Build the custom Framer Motion scroll container and interactive morphing components to replace legacy Vanilla JS scroll-engine and progress-rail.

items.label: Rich Media / YouTube Integration
items.instructions: Implement a seamless, custom video player overlay for YouTube assets within the CinematicSection.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Core features (System B - Workspace Complete)

items.label: System A Animation Performance Pass
items.instructions: Ensure Framer Motion animations run at 60fps on mobile. Verify layout morphs do not cause layout thrashing.

items.label: Portrait/Landscape Composition Pass
items.instructions: Test all views on mobile (portrait) and desktop (landscape). Verify data tables in System B scroll horizontally, and 3D/parallax effects in System A scale correctly.

items.label: Accessibility (a11y) Pass
items.instructions: Ensure keyboard navigation works in System B. Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion' media queries for System A animations.

items.label: Initial GitHub Pages Deployment
items.instructions: Confirm .github/workflows/deploy.yml has completed at least one successful run and the site is live and correctly serving the Vite bundle at the expected gh-pages URL.

openDecisions.text: Brand assets / final palette not yet confirmed.
USANA distributor policy review for any PUBLIC content.
Which React UI ecosystem/library to adopt.
openDecisions.resolution: Split architecture adopted: Mantine UI used for data-heavy administrative System B. Custom React + Framer Motion used for cinematic, gamified System A.
